results.title: Credit Risk Analyst
results.description: Our client, a leading investment bank in the City of London, is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst to join its wholesale credit team. You will review counterparty exposures across the trading book, prepare annual credit reviews for corporate and financial institution clients, and work closely with the front office on new transaction approvals. Strong SQL and Python skills are expected, along with a good understanding of Basel III capital requirements and IFRS 9 provisioning. Candidates should hold a relevant degree and ideally be studying towards a professional qualification.

results.title: Regulatory Reporting Manager
results.description: A global asset manager seeks a Regulatory Reporting Manager to own COREP and FINREP submissions. Experience with the PRA reporting framework is essential. & strong Excel skills required.

results.title: Junior Operations Analyst
results.description: Support the settlements desk of a mid-sized brokerage. Full training given.
